note: Shared golden cases for wording a clock difference. Go's ntpcheck.describeGap (which builds the sentence under the table) and the TypeScript describeOffset in frontend/src/tools/ntp-check/offset.ts (which fills the Difference column) must agree, or a row will read 7 m 12 s in one place and 7 m 13 s in the other. Go asserts describeGap(ms) == gap; TypeScript asserts describeOffset(ms) == '+' + gap and describeOffset(-ms) == '-' + gap, except for 0 which has no negative form. See SPECS/CONVENTIONS.md section 8.
